description: This file defines the BucketEndpointMiddleware class used to modify request endpoints for AWS S3 bucket operations, particularly handling bucket host and path adjustments when using bucket endpoints or CNAME buckets.

classes.name: BucketEndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for adjusting request host and path in S3 operations to handle bucket endpoint URL formats.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that can be used to instantiate the middleware with a handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler in the chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to potentially modify the request based on the bucket name and command.

methods.name: removeBucketFromPath
methods.description: Removes the bucket name from the request path if present, adjusting for multiple occurrences.

methods.name: removeDuplicateBucketFromHost
methods.description: Removes duplicate bucket names from the host component.

methods.name: getBucketNameOccurrencesInKey
methods.description: Counts how many times the bucket name occurs in the key path segments.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI to update host and path according to the bucket endpoint logic.
